column1: # Every .env key, for the portal's Settings page and ./stack config (lib/settings.sh). ./stack copies this table into
# .state/status/settings.json together with each value (masked), so the portal never reads .env.
# The update helper takes its allowlist from here (policy column) and checks every value with the validator named
# here (lib/settings.sh: _sv_<validator>; the portal mirrors them in portal/portal/settings.py).
# key  group  secret  policy  validator  apply  label  note  cli
#   group    account | aws | budgets | voice | openrouter | files | updates | remote | advanced
#   secret   - plain (shown) | s sensitive, shown (an email, a login) | k key id (first 4 … last 4) | u URL (host only)
#            | h secret, last 4 shown | S secret, nothing shown
#   policy   edit (from the portal; remotely only with REMOTE_ADMIN_ACTIONS=true) | local (only from the computer
#            running bedrock-now) | on-only (may be turned on, never off) | widen-local (off anywhere, on only
#            locally) | companion (only together with its key: PORTAL_PASSWORD_HASH) | ro | derived (written by ./stack)
#   apply    what ./stack config apply does after writing .env (comma list; - = nothing, read when needed)
